verdict.rationale: The built-in Gemini assistant takes delegated work inside the product. It answers source-grounded questions with citations and can adopt custom roles. It generates study guides, briefings, reports, slide decks, mind maps, quizzes, and audio/video overviews on request. Deep Research / Fast Research modes gather web sources into the notebook for the user. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-step agentic task execution or actions beyond content generation and research within the notebook, and independent hands-on corroboration of Deep Research delegation (one community comment predates it and says the product could not search for sources itself).
